## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1] and backbone agreement support InSitu, though frozen-section margins appear involved [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 97%, Invasive 2%, Benign 1% | Strong separation; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu (90% target, alpha 0.1) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 96th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent backbones agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; nearest Invasive (86%) | Majority match; closest neighbor Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical confinement (-0.733) strongly opposes invasion [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical stromal infiltration (-0.48) opposes invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Typical locally; slightly raises risk (+0.254) [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Descriptive TIL signal (+0.241) only · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Minor shift (+0.174); 0/20 spot checks · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 spans 0); normal lobules, mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion in region 9 (35% risk) or region 10 matches nearest neighbor BACH_0138 (Invasive, 86% similarity).
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts, severity-3 JPEG degradation, and 96th-percentile OOD shift mask invasion or inflate margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 5, 4**: Highest invasive risk (35%, 13%, 10%); exclude invasion and pleomorphism versus BACH_0138.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 5, 10**: Confirm ductal confinement (regions 3–5) and rule out stromal infiltration in region 10.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8, 11**: Verify superior, medial, and lateral margins (108 um); stain orders blocked on frozen section.
